bias.en: Uptrend, pulling back · lost the 5, 10 and 30-day, SAR bearish
bias.zh: 上升趋势、回调中 · 跌破 5、10 和 30 日均线，SAR 转空

read.en: Microsoft fell 1.6% on Oct 30 to $521.91 (range $514.35–526.00) on 1.7 times average volume. It is below the rising 5-day ($529.40), the falling 10-day ($529.09) and, just, the rising 30-day ($523.18), and well above the rising 100-day ($465.52) and 200-day ($437.93). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19, still above zero, histogram widening slowly; Parabolic SAR turned bearish on Oct 30 ($541.29), and RSI is 49.
read.zh: 微软 10月30日下跌 1.6%，收于 $521.91（区间 $514.35–526.00），成交量为均量的 1.7 倍。股价低于上行的 5 日均线（$529.40）、下行的 10 日均线（$529.09），并略低于上行的 30 日均线（$523.18），远高于上行的 100 日（$465.52）和 200 日均线（$437.93）。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图缓慢扩大；抛物线 SAR 于 10月30日转为看空（$541.29），RSI 为 49。

read.en: The Oct 29 spike to $541.29 failed above the $535.6 cap, and Oct 30 broke the $526–531 support (5 and 10-day), now resistance. Resistance is $523.2–526 (30-day, Oct 30 high), then $529–531 and $541.3 (Oct 29 high, SAR). Support is $514.4–515.7 (Oct 30 and Oct 23 lows), then $497–502 and $486 (Sep 10 low). A close above $531 would target $535.6–541; below $514, $497–502.
